<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template for electrophilic aromatic bromination, I will search the template catalog for a transformation that forms a halide (C–Br) on an aromatic ring. Using a simple aromatic bromide product (c1ccccc1Br) as the target molecule, I will query the catalog for templates that form a halide functional group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccccc1Br",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["halide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
